# anymd

> Any file to clean Markdown for AI agents: PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, EPUB, HTML and web pages, images (OCR), audio and video (metadata, subtitles, transcripts). A fast Rust MCP server and CLI that runs on your machine. No API key.

anymd is a Rust command-line tool and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server published by Sylphx Limited (`https://sylphx.com`). It converts documents, slides, spreadsheets, e-books, web pages, images, and audio/video files into clean, structured Markdown locally on your machine with no API key required (96.4 overall score across 38 documents in 11.5 s on AgentDocBench). Hosted metered parsing is available at Sylphx AI parse (`https://sylphx.com/ai`).

anymd Pro ($29 USD / £24 GBP / €27 EUR / HK$228 one-time, 100-year offline Ed25519 licence) adds deterministic PDF `cite_check` and SHA-256 verifiable video timelines and frame extraction.

## Install and Setup

- npm: `npx -y @sylphx/anymd setup --client cursor,claude,codex`
- Cargo: `cargo install anymd`
- Homebrew: `brew install sylphxai/tap/anymd`
- Windows: `winget install Sylphx.anymd`
